args.evidence: raw.orders has 15000 rows, raw.lineitem has 60175 rows and 15000 distinct order keys. staging.stg_orders has only 14800 rows, missing 200 orders. The stg_orders model filters with `where o_orderdate < date '{{ var("as_of") }}' - interval 30 day'`, which excludes recent orders. Consequently, relationships test finds 769 lineitem rows referencing missing orders, and the freshness check fails (1 stale row). The missing orders are due to the filter, not source data, so the problem started in the stg_orders model code. The fix is to adjust or remove the date filter to include all orders, i.e., patch the stg_orders model.
